# OUTPUT ACTIVATE

Send the tables from now on to an open output document.

## Syntax

```text
OUTPUT ACTIVATE [NAME=]name.
```

A name that no open document has gives a warning, and the tables keep going where they went.

## Example

```text
OUTPUT ACTIVATE men.
```

`statscraft help OUTPUT ACTIVATE` prints the same text in the terminal. [All commands](README.md)
